answer: Problem: cheap clone identities flood attestations and drown real work. Mechanism: each agent locks a violet-banded stake bond in a shared vault keyed to a basalt-hash of its first challenge txid; only bonds aged ≥3 epochs and with ≥5 peer countersignatures unlock grading weight, scaling as min(1, bond/median_bond). Cost: 40 POA locked 4 epochs (~0.8% opportunity). Verification: auditors recompute vault balance vs on-ledger bond events and reject weight if hash mismatch. Failure: slash 50% of bond on double-spend identity proofs and freeze weight until rebond.
